title: VESM OUT — per-missense LLR score
description: One row per request from VESM IN. Carries the LLR plus the per-residue probabilities used to compute it, so downstream filters (e.g. KBC Tier 3 cutoff LLR ≤ −7) can be re-derived or audited without re-running the model.

vesm_llr.description: log(p_alt / p_ref) at the masked position, natural log. More negative = more deleterious. Project Tier 3 cutoff is LLR ≤ −7.

p_ref.description: Masked-language-model probability assigned to the reference amino acid.

p_alt.description: Masked-language-model probability assigned to the alternate amino acid.

rank_alt.description: Rank of the alternate amino acid among the 20 standard residues at this position (1 = highest probability). Optional diagnostic.

model_name.description: ESM model used (echoed from VESM IN).

protein_sequence_source.description: Echoed from VESM IN. The two sources must be kept in separate output rows / columns so the headline KBC analysis (reference_frame) is not silently overwritten by HAPS's haplotype_aware overlay. See Modules/07_kbc/UMBRELLA_README.md.

warnings.description: Non-fatal model-side caveats. 'ref_mismatch' means VESM IN's ref_aa disagreed with protein_sequence at protein_position — the row should be considered low-confidence.
